name: ENGR 150 module handbook with dd.mm dates
text:
ENGR 150 Engineering Mechanics — Module Handbook, Autumn Term 2026
Module leader: Dr. Katrin Vogel · Lectures Mon 10:00 and Thu 14:00, Room E1.12
Tutorials: Wednesdays 09:00, Lab 2.04

1. Aims
This module introduces statics and dynamics of rigid bodies with applications to
structures and machines. Students completing it can model and analyse loads.

2. Assessment
Assessment component        Weighting   Deadline
Coursework 1 (statics)      10%         02.10.2026
Coursework 2 (trusses)      10%         23.10.2026
Lab report: friction        15%         06.11.2026
Class test                  15%         12.11.2026
Coursework 3 (dynamics)     10%         27.11.2026
Final examination           40%         January exam period (date TBC)

All coursework is submitted online by 16:00 on the deadline date.

3. Teaching schedule
Wk  Date        Topic
1   28.09.      Forces, vectors, equilibrium
2   05.10.      Moments and couples
3   12.10.      Free-body diagrams
4   19.10.      Trusses: method of joints
5   26.10.      Trusses: method of sections
6   02.11.      Friction (lab week)
7   09.11.      Centroids — class test Thursday 12.11.
8   16.11.      Kinematics of particles
9   23.11.      Kinetics: Newton's laws
10  30.11.      Work and energy
11  07.12.      Impulse and momentum; revision

4. Key dates
- Coursework 1 hand-in: 2 October 2026
- Coursework 2 hand-in: 23 October 2026
- Friction lab report hand-in: 6 November 2026
- Class test: 12 November 2026 (in the Thursday lecture)
- Coursework 3 hand-in: 27 November 2026
- Revision lecture: 10 December 2026

5. Academic integrity
Collusion and plagiarism are treated under the university misconduct regulations.
notes: Final examination date is TBC and excluded; the revision lecture is not a deliverable.
